objectives: independently verify archive integrity, structured mesh geometry, and eigenvalue-to-frequency conversion for all five meshes

model.support: soft simply supported: transverse displacement w=0 on all edges; both independent section rotations are unconstrained and take the natural moment conditions
model.j5b_in_plane_pins: remove in-plane rigid modes; they are decoupled from the flat isotropic flexural continuum reference without prestress
model.mass: areal translational mass rho*h and rotary inertia rho*h^3/12 for each section rotation

kirchhoff_navier.source: A. W. Leissa, NASA SP-160: Vibration of Plates, 1969
kirchhoff_navier.role: thin-plate context only; does not include shear or rotary inertia

mindlin_soft_support.method: independent Galerkin/Rayleigh-Ritz discretization of the Reissner-Mindlin continuum energy; no QF Solver assembly, API, or element code imported
mindlin_soft_support.primary_model_source: R. D. Mindlin, Influence of Rotatory Inertia and Shear on Flexural Motions of Isotropic, Elastic Plates, 1951, DOI 10.1115/1.4010217
mindlin_soft_support.soft_hard_support_source: D. N. Arnold and R. S. Falk, The Plate Paradox for Hard and Soft Simple Support, SIAM J. Math. Anal. 21(3), 1990, DOI 10.1137/0521030
mindlin_soft_support.support_compatibility: w=0 with rotations free is soft support; hard-support frequency tables with an edge tangential rotation constrained are not used as direct comparisons
mindlin_soft_support.energy_terms: bending D, shear kappa*G*h, translational mass rho*h, rotary inertia rho*h^3/12
mindlin_soft_support.rotation_basis: tensor Legendre polynomials on the full plate; no essential rotation boundary condition
mindlin_soft_support.transverse_basis: sin(m*pi*x/a)*sin(n*pi*y/b), m,n=1..Nw, satisfying w=0 on all edges

predeclared_indicators.subspace_mac_definition: minimum squared singular value of Qqf^T*Qref after independent Euclidean QR; this reproduces J5B's unweighted nodal UZ metric and is not a mass MAC
predeclared_indicators.continuum_shape_metric: quadrature-weighted L2 MAC of bilinear QF UZ interpolation and independent Ritz w fields; repeated pair compared by minimum principal-angle squared in the same weighted function space
predeclared_indicators.ritz_nested_space_indicator: reported frequencies should be non-increasing as a nested Ritz basis expands; flag increases exceeding 1e-8 relative as a numerical implementation issue
predeclared_indicators.status_rule: all new comparisons are diagnostic; no result may promote a J5B INCONCLUSIVE state
